entry.title: Optional Task: Use Joule CDS Unit Test Generation
entry.content:
Thank you to everyone who participated in the ABAP Developer Challenge over the past four weeks and successfully completed all four tasks focused on ABAP AI capabilities. We truly appreciate the enthusiasm and engagement shown throughout the challenge. As a follow-up, we are excited to introduce an additional bonus task.

In Week 2, you enhanced a CDS data definition by implementing simple logic. Building on that work, your next step is to create an ABAP test class to validate the logic within the CDS data definition. For this task, you will utilize another feature of Joule’s ABAP AI capabilities — CDS Test Generation.

Task:

  • Select the CDS data definition that you enhanced in Week 2.
  • Generate an ABAP test class using Joule’s CDS Test Generation feature.
  • Execute the test class and ensure that all generated test cases run successfully.

Please refer to the link below for detailed guidance on how to use this ABAP AI capability.

https://help.sap.com/docs/abap-cloud/abap-development-tools-user-guide/use-cds-test-class-generator?locale=en-US

entry.title: 🇮🇳 SAP CodeJam ABAP: SAP BTP, ABAP Environment & RAP ( Pune, India )
entry.content:
We hit the limit of 25 attendees on April 24th and all RSVPs after that will be considered a waiting list.

This SAP CodeJam event is on the topic of the ABAP Cloud, and specifically introduces attendees to ABAP Cloud and the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model. ABAP Cloud is the ABAP-based development model for S/4HANA Cloud, S/4HANA on-premise, and SAP BTP, ABAP environment.

Learn how to use proven and new technologies, such as Core Data Services (CDS) and behavior definition and implementation languages, to build SAP Fiori apps and OData services on any of the ABAP Cloud options. In this hands-on experience, developers will create their first ABAP applications using ABAP Cloud, expose and consume services via HTTP, and explore the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model.

This is an in-person event only (not virtual) and is planned for Tuesday 26th May 2026 in Pune from 09:00 - 15:30 IST. The language and content of the event will be in English.

Location: Bloomberg Data Services (India) Private Ltd, SkyOne, S. No. 210, 5th Floor, Kalyani Nagar, Village Yerwada, Pune, IN, 411006.

The event is kindly hosted by Bloomberg Data Services (India) Private Ltd. Thank you! Please note that spaces are limited - we can only accommodate 25 attendees. If you wish to attend, register by clicking the Yes button in the Will you be attending? section above to the right. A few weeks before the event, we will ask you to confirm your attendance.

The instructor is Developer Advocate @Shilpa_Shankar

There are essential prerequisites that must be completed by every attendee, before arriving at the event location. They are documented here: abap-exercises-codejam/prerequisites.md at main · SAP-samples/abap-exercises-codejam (github.com).

For more information on SAP CodeJam events, to ask questions, and to chat with your fellow attendees, head over to the SAP CodeJam group.

entry.title: Devtoberfest 2026: Welcome to a New Season of Learning, Coding & Innovation
entry.content:
It’s almost time for Devtoberfest 2026! 🎉

Get ready for another exciting season of learning, coding, and community as we bring developers together to explore what’s new across the SAP technology landscape.

Devtoberfest, an SAP TechED event is a month-long virtual festival from September 21 - October 18, 2026 for developers focused on learning, coding, and community collaboration. 

  • It’s free to join
  • Open to developers of all skill levels
  • Designed to help people prepare for SAP’s major developer event – SAP TechEd
I’ll repeat the same overall description we’ve used the past few years as it does an excellent job of capturing the spirit of the event:
 
Devtoberfest is an attempt to capture the experience of the pre-conference events, like SAP InnoJam of years’ past. It’s an event which kicks off the SAP TechEd season. Devtoberfest takes some of the best aspects of the traditional hackathon type event, such as learning by building something, but opens the experience to the entire community and spreads across multiple weeks to better accommodate everyone’s busy schedules. It’s an event that is also designed for you to be able to participate asynchronously and on your own time schedule. As the idea formed, we’ve seen an opportunity here to really build something that is truly a festival for developers.
 
And this year, we have something new to kick things off: a brand-new Devtoberfest landing page!

We’re excited to introduce the new SAP Devtoberfest 2026 landing page, your starting point for everything about Devtoberfest.

👉 Start exploring today: SAP Devtoberfest 2026

The landing page brings together everything you need to get started, including the program, tracks, registration details, and the latest Devtoberfest updates.

So, if you’re wondering what’s happening, what you can learn, and how to get involved, this is the place to begin.

📝 How to register for Devtoberfest 2026

1. Visit the Devtoberfest page.

2. Login to the Developer Center via the user menu (top right)

3. Once logged in, click on Join the Fest button.

4. That's it and You're In.  Explore the various Activities.

5. THE WEEKS lists all the Devtoberfest sessions in the calendar. You can filter by the various tracks.

6. ACTIVITIES lists the Devtoberfest Schedule. This lists all the educational sessions which can be viewed Live on SAP Developers YouTube channel. All the tutorials through which you can earn points is listed under the type “Activity”. You can filter out on the Week, Track and type of Activity to keep a track of the sessions and tutorials. 

7. Click on Arcade and Leaderboard to check points and the Gameboard. Many different activities (tutorials, scavenger hunt, attending educational sessions, etc.) that would all be worth some points per activity. The more activities people do, the more points they earn. 

 
Educational Content
The backbone of Devtoberfest remains the educational content sessions. Devtoberfest is still an event designed for asynchronous consumption. While we will release content every weekday during Devtoberfest, it's all intended that you consume the content on your own schedule.
 
This year's tracks are the following:

🟢 Monday – Extending the Core

🟣 Tuesday – Data

🔴Wednesday – Integration

🔵Thursday – AI

🟠 Friday – Building Apps

🟡 All Week – Fun Activities

 
Fun Activities
This is a celebration so the Fun Friday activities will return, somewhat. We have lots of fun activities sprinkled in throughout the week! There will be pro-active fun activities but also community fun activities like Petoberfest happening over the span of Devtoberfest.
 
The Contest
The winners of 2025 are joining us this year (2026) in Berlin for SAP TechEd to learn, and to engage with SAP and the community! Congratulations to our 2025 winners!
 
When something works that well, why change it up; so again this year the Grand Prize 2026 will be held at an SAP TechEd Barcelona in the second half of 2027.
 
For all the information on the Content
  • Devtoberfest Official Rules
  • FAQ 
Questions, Comments, or Feedback
Questions about the event? Or the judging? Or you have a follow up question after participating in one of the educational enablement sessions? For any question or comment related to Devtoberfest we ask that you please use the dedicated Devtoberfest Discussions board available here.
